messages:
nina: Hi folks, excited to start Monday! A couple of security/onboarding Qs I wanted to sort out beforehand:
1) I'm primarily mobile-first and would prefer using my personal iPhone for MFA and Slack. Is that allowed for new hires or do you require a company device for first 30 days?
2) My role needs temporary badge access to the CICD lab for 1 week. Who authorizes short-term badge grants?
3) When does the phishsim enrollment happen for new engineering hires?

people-ops: Welcome @nina :tada:
Short answers: personal phones ok for MFA but we prefer company-managed devices for anything that stores secrets. Badge access is manager-approved + security sign-off. Phishsim is added within first 3 business days. If you want step-by-step I'll outline below.

security-lead: Hi Nina 144b Please note the policy: personal iOS devices may be used for MFA (Authenticator apps or YubiKey via NFC) but personal devices that access internal apps or corp email must enroll in our MDM "BYOD" profile. That profile enforces passcode, device encryption, and blocklist policies. If you decline BYOD enrollment, we issue a temporary company phone for the first 30 days.
A few specifics:
- BYOD MDM only sees device posture (compliance flags), not personal photos/files.
- We do not allow backup of corp app data to personal cloud services with BYOD profiles enabled.
- NFC YubiKey flow is supported on iPhone 8+.

nina: Thanks. If I enroll my phone in BYOD MDM, will the company be able to remote-wipe my phone?

security-lead: On BYOD we only request selective remote wipe (corporate data) not full device wipe. The MDM agent supports "selective wipe" that removes corp apps and corp-managed VPN/profiles. Full device wipe is only for lost/stolen company-owned devices after escalation.

it-sr: For badge access: manager must submit a short access request form (https://it.redwood.internal/badge-requests) with dates, team, and reason. Security triages it and we provision a temporary badge via facilities. For lab access specifically we also require completion of the lab safety + data handling micro-training (10m). If you need the badge within 24 hours, have your manager mark it as "urgent" and cc security.

nina: Got it. Who on security approves the BYOD profile? Is that self-serve during onboarding?

security-lead: BYOD enrollment is self-serve via the MDM prompt once you hit the company SSO and install the profile. We'll send an enrollment link after you accept the SSO invite. There is an optional attestation call if you have unusual device posture (jailbroken/rooted, outdated OS). If your phone is flagged, we'll offer a loaner.

phishsim-bot: Scheduled phish simulation enrollment: nina added to "new-hires-engineering" cohort. First simulated phish will be sent ~3 business days after first_message_ts. Failure leads to 20-min micro-training and manager notification.

nina: Perfect. One more quick question 147a: I occasionally need to demo internal dashboards on my tablet during offsite meetings. Can I mirror my laptop to an iPad that is not MDM-enrolled?

security-lead: We prefer mirroring to only company-managed displays or to devices enrolled in BYOD. If you must mirror to a personal iPad that is not enrolled, ensure no sensitive tokens are cached on the mirrored session and avoid viewing PII. For recurring demos, request a meeting-room device from facilities.

nina: Thanks all, this is super helpful. I'll enroll BYOD tonight and ask my manager to file the badge request. Appreciate the quick responses! :smile:
